caustics.prompt: Game texture, BrineSpace underwater caustics: a seamless square greyscale caustic ripple map, fine irregular interlocking refracted water-light veins with quiet dark gaps, subtle hand-painted fine pixel-scale dithered edges, restrained matte finish. White luminance on black, no color, no objects, no text, no border, no vignette, uniform density across entire square, perfectly repeating opposite edges. Broad gently curved cells with smaller fragmented threads, no sharp vector lines or glossy photographic highlights. Intended to be reduced to 512x512 and gently added to deep teal water.
caustics.bake: 512px luminance, separable sin-squared half-period blending, matched opposite texels, contrast exponent 1.55

native_shapes.tool: deterministic Python/NumPy bake extending existing procedural art
native_shapes.lamp: Original RoomLighting 64px squared radial profile and Bayer threshold expanded 2x. Warm/cool identical luminance; runtime tint controls color.
native_shapes.wide: Squared elliptical falloff radii 62x27, seven alpha bands with 4x4 Bayer thresholds. Review-only.
native_shapes.shafts: Three broad diagonal Gaussian profiles with subtly curved centres, uneven widths and fine dim thread modulation; 24 alpha bands and fully transparent boundaries. Review-only.
native_shapes.bubbles: Registered 12px rims with restrained 0.13/0.10px angular irregularity, pale blue alpha .84 and white northwest highlight. Existing .5 runtime fade gives original .42 rim alpha.
native_shapes.beacon: Original directional lobe with 24 alpha bands and subtle Bayer thresholds at 1px detail; unchanged runtime red tint/radius/orbit/rate.

style_pass.prompt: Edit Image 1, the existing square greyscale caustic map. Image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: BrineSpace's accepted matte, finely hand-painted game props. Produce a square seamless GREYSCALE underwater light-caustic texture: substantially simplify the original dense photographic spiderweb into broad irregular drifting islands/arcs of diffuse water light, with quiet dark open areas occupying roughly 70 percent of the image. Around 10 to 16 broad cells across the square, a few short broken secondary threads. Softly painted fine pixel-scale edges, subtle tonal stepping, controlled detail and gently uneven line widths. No crisp geometric lattice, bright white veins, chrome glints, photographic sparkle, noisy grit, muddy blur, vignette or border. Most light is middle grey, occasional small brighter intersections; keep a dark background for the shader's luminance channel. Preserve the square tile purpose and seamless opposite edges, uniform visual density across the whole image. No props or objects from the style reference, no color, no text. This is ambient light behind the station, secondary to alien sea life.
style_pass.bake: Same deterministic seamless luminance bake; prior source retained. See bake.py and review/style-audit.json.
